raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Migrate `ModernBertModel` (embedding), `ModernBertForSequenceClassification` (reranker) and `ModernBertForTokenClassification` to the Transformers modeling backend. This is the first encoder-only migration, chosen because ModernBERT needs neither `token_type_ids` nor RoBERTa's position offset, which the backend does not support yet.

`modernbert.py` keeps only the base model and its layers, which `ColBERTModernBertModel` and `ColModernVBert` still use.

## Claims

- All three ModernBERT architectures resolve to the Transformers backend and match HF (fp32) and their MTEB references.
- **Classifier heads** (`fusers/classifier.py`): a new `ClassifierFuser` traces the HF `For*Classification` model and adopts everything between the pooled hidden states and `classifier`/`score` (ModernBERT's `head`: dense, activation, norm). The head runs in the model dtype and only the classifier in `head_dtype`. This is most of the PR's ~250 new runtime lines. A generic trace replaces per-model head code, so later encoder migrations get their heads for free. #61349 (DistilBERT) currently adds a per-model head table instead.
- **Unmatched heads fail closed**: if no head matches, the classifier alone is used only when it reads the last hidden state (RoBERTa, decoders' `score`). Otherwise (DistilBERT, BERT's `pooler_output`, DeBERTa's `pooler`) loading raises instead of returning wrong scores.
- **Token classification**: new `TransformersForTokenClassification`.
- **`classifier_pooling`**: if the config sets it (`"cls"` or `"mean"`) and the user did not set a pooling type, it is used. `gte-reranker-modernbert-base` uses `"mean"`.
- **Bidirectional sliding window**: Transformers' window includes both boundaries, so encoder models get `sliding_window + 1`, as native `modernbert.py` already did.
- **Scale expressions**: `AttentionFuser` now resolves simple arithmetic (`**`, `*`, `/`, unary `-`) on literals and `self.<attr>`, needed for ModernBERT's `scaling=self.head_dim**-0.5`.
- **Online FP8 tolerance** widened from 2e-3 to 2.5e-3 in `test_modernbert_fp8.py`. Both implementations quantize the same 88 linears with one per-tensor scale each. Unquantized, the backend is closer to the reference than native. With FP8 it lands 5e-4 further away (see below).
- Known regression: ModernBERT has no TP plan in Transformers and its packed `Wqkv` is not fused, so it has no tensor parallelism. The model is ~150M params.

## Validation

HF parity on CPU (M-series Mac, fp32 for both HF and vLLM, `enforce_eager=True`):

| Model | Check | HF | vLLM |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Alibaba-NLP/gte-modernbert-base` | CLS embedding cosine sim, 3 texts (one ~500 tokens, past the 128-token local window) | 1.0 | 0.9999998, 1.0000002, 1.0000002 |
| `Alibaba-NLP/gte-reranker-modernbert-base` | `sigmoid(logits)` vs `LLM.score`, 2 pairs | 0.974610, 0.130569 | 0.974610, 0.130569 |
| `disham993/electrical-ner-ModernBERT-base` | per-token probabilities, 3 texts | | max abs diff 1.1e-5, argmax identical |

Ablations (earlier revision, each fix disabled on its own):

| Fix disabled | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Sliding window `+1` | long-text cosine sim drops to 0.99996 |
| `classifier_pooling` | reranker scores 0.990, 0.515 |

The fail-closed fallback was also run end to end. `papluca/xlm-roberta-base-language-detection`, the `TransformersForSequenceClassification` test model, takes the classifier-only path and matches HF to 9.5e-7.

MTEB, `gte-modernbert-base` on B200, fp16 (reference 0.748193):

| | `main` | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unquantized | 0.748174 (diff 1.9e-5) | 0.748190 (diff 3.8e-6) |
| Online FP8 | 0.746634 (diff 1.56e-3) | 0.746152 (diff 2.04e-3) |

GPU tests on this PR (B200 runs used a locally lowered default `gpu_memory_utilization` because the GPUs were shared; `test_backend.py` was also run on `main` for comparison):

| Test | GPU | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pooling_mteb_test/test_gte.py` (both ModernBERT models) | A100 | 2 passed |
| `pooling_mteb_test/test_modernbert_fp8.py` | B200 | passed |
| `pooling/test_token_classification.py -k modernbert` | A100 | passed |
| `pooling/test_colbert.py -k modernbert` | A100 | 7 passed |
| `multimodal/pooling/test_colmodernvbert.py` | A100 | 4 passed |
| `transformers/test_backend.py` | B200 | 38 passed, 1 skipped (`main`: 37 passed, 1 skipped) |
| `transformers/fusers/test_classifier.py` | B200 | 11 passed |
| `test_initialization.py -k "ModernBert or TransformersFor or TransformersEmbedding"` | B200 | 8 passed |
| `test_registry.py -k "ModernBert or Transformers"` | B200 | 15 passed |

On A100, `test_modernbert_fp8.py` fails on both `main` and this PR with the same Marlin workspace assertion (`marlin_locks ... was not allocated during warmup`). CI runs it on H200.

Throughput (req/s, `LLM.embed`/`LLM.score`/`LLM.encode`, 10k requests of 512 tokens):

| Task | A100 `main` | A100 PR | B200 `main` | B200 PR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| embed | 699.8 | 704.7 | 1383 | 1352 |
| score | 489.4 | 493.8 | 1239 | 1279 |
| token classify | 762.2 | 727.1 | 1533 | 1502 |

A100: best of 3 on an earlier revision (only the classifier head code has changed since). B200: best of 9 (3 interleaved rounds of 3). Runs on the shared B200 host varied by up to 2x, so its differences are within noise.

```bash
pytest tests/models/language/pooling_mteb_test/test_gte.py -k "model_info10 or (test_rerank_models_mteb and model_info0)"
pytest tests/models/language/pooling_mteb_test/test_modernbert_fp8.py
pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_token_classification.py -k modernbert
pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_colbert.py -k modernbert
pytest tests/models/multimodal/pooling/test_colmodernvbert.py
pytest tests/models/transformers/test_backend.py
pytest tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_classifier.py
pytest tests/models/test_initialization.py -k "ModernBert or TransformersFor or TransformersEmbedding"
pytest tests/models/test_registry.py -k "ModernBert or Transformers"
```

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Unit tests for the Transformers modeling backend's classifier fuser."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from transformers import (
+    AutoConfig,
+    AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
+    AutoModelForTokenClassification,
+)
+
+from vllm.model_executor.models.transformers.fusers import ClassifierFuser
+from vllm.model_executor.models.transformers.fusers.classifier import (
+    trace_classification_model,
+)
+
+
+def build(auto_cls, model_type: str, device: str = "meta", **overrides):
+    config = AutoConfig.for_model(model_type, **overrides)
+    with torch.device(device):
+        return auto_cls.from_config(config).eval()
+
+
+def vllm_config(dtype=torch.float32, head_dtype=torch.float32):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(dtype=dtype, head_dtype=head_dtype)
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("auto_cls", "pooling"),
+    [
+        (AutoModelForSequenceClassification, "cls"),
+        (AutoModelForSequenceClassification, "mean"),
+        (AutoModelForTokenClassification, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_modernbert_head_matches_hf(auto_cls, pooling):
+    """The fused head applied to vLLM-pooled hidden states reproduces HF's logits."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    model = build(
+        auto_cls,
+        "modernbert",
+        device="cpu",
+        hidden_size=32,
+        intermediate_size=64,
+        num_hidden_layers=1,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+        classifier_pooling=pooling or "cls",
+    )
+    pooled = pooling is not None
+    fuser = ClassifierFuser.match_model(model, pooled=pooled)
+    assert fuser is not None
+    head = fuser.fuse(model, "", vllm_config())
+
+    input_ids = torch.randint(0, model.config.vocab_size, (1, 6))
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        hidden = model.model(input_ids).last_hidden_state[0]
+        if pooling == "cls":
+            hidden = hidden[:1]
+        elif pooling == "mean":
+            hidden = hidden.mean(0, keepdim=True)
+        expected = model(input_ids).logits.reshape(hidden.shape[0], -1)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(head(hidden), expected)
+
+
+def test_head_matches_with_compiled_base_model():
+    """`@support_torch_compile` overriding the base model's `__call__` is traced."""
+    model = build(AutoModelForSequenceClassification, "modernbert")
+    base_cls = type(model.model)
+    model.model.__class__ = type(
+        base_cls.__name__,
+        (base_cls,),
+        {"__call__": lambda self, *args, **kwargs: self.forward(*args, **kwargs)},
+    )
+    assert ClassifierFuser.match_model(model, pooled=True) is not None
+
+
+def test_matching_does_not_change_config():
+    """Tracing `labels` must not set `problem_type`, which picks the activation."""
+    model = build(AutoModelForSequenceClassification, "modernbert", num_labels=1)
+    ClassifierFuser.match_model(model, pooled=True)
+    assert model.config.problem_type is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("model_type", "classifier_only", "reason"),
+    [
+        ("distilbert", False, "applies an inline `nn.ReLU()`, which ends the trace"),
+        ("deberta-v2", False, "pools inside its `pooler` module"),
+        ("bert", False, "classifies the base model's `pooler_output`"),
+        ("roberta", True, "pools inside its `classifier` module"),
+        ("qwen2", True, "scores every token before pooling"),
+    ],
+    ids=["distilbert", "deberta-v2", "bert", "roberta", "qwen2"],
+)
+def test_unsupported_heads_are_not_matched(model_type, classifier_only, reason):
+    """Unmatched heads may only fall back to a classifier that reads hidden states."""
+    model = build(AutoModelForSequenceClassification, model_type, num_hidden_layers=1)
+    graph = trace_classification_model(model)
+    assert ClassifierFuser.match(graph, model, pooled=True) is None, reason
+    assert ClassifierFuser.classifies_hidden_states(graph, model) is classifier_only
+
+
+def test_only_classifier_runs_in_head_dtype():
+    """Like native models, the head runs in the model dtype, the classifier doesn't."""
+    model = build(
+        AutoModelForTokenClassification,
+        "modernbert",
+        device="cpu",
+        hidden_size=32,
+        intermediate_size=64,
+        num_hidden_layers=1,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+    ).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    model.classifier.float()
+    fuser = ClassifierFuser.match_model(model, pooled=False)
+    head = fuser.fuse(model, "", vllm_config(torch.bfloat16, torch.float32))
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        logits = head(torch.randn(6, 32, dtype=torch.float32))
+    assert logits.dtype == torch.float32

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Classifier fuser: extract the head of a `For*Classification` model.
+
+The head is everything between the pooled hidden states and the classifier, e.g.
+ModernBERT's `head` (dense, activation, norm). vLLM's pooler replaces whatever
+pools the base model's output, so only the head after it is kept.
+"""
+
+import copy
+import inspect
+import operator
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from torch import fx, nn
+from transformers.modeling_outputs import BaseModelOutput
+
+from vllm.model_executor.models.transformers.fusers.base import BaseFuser
+from vllm.model_executor.models.transformers.fx_utils import (
+    _AllLeafTracer,
+    find_node,
+    forward_parameters,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+
+class _ClassifierTracer(_AllLeafTracer):
+    """Tracer that stubs the base model with `[1, seq_len, hidden_size]` output."""
+
+    def _infer_meta(self, kind: str, target: object, args: tuple, kwargs: dict):
+        root = self.root
+        assert isinstance(root, nn.Module)
+        if kind == "placeholder" and str(target) in ("input_ids", "attention_mask"):
+            return torch.ones(1, 8, dtype=torch.long, device="meta")
+        if kind == "call_module" and str(target) == root.base_model_prefix:
+            param = next(root.parameters())
+            hidden_size = root.config.get_text_config().hidden_size
+            hidden_states = torch.empty(
+                1, 8, hidden_size, dtype=param.dtype, device="meta"
+            )
+            return BaseModelOutput(last_hidden_state=hidden_states)
+        return super()._infer_meta(kind, target, args, kwargs)
+
+    def create_proxy(self, kind, target, args, kwargs, *extra, **extra_kwargs):
+        proxy = super().create_proxy(kind, target, args, kwargs, *extra, **extra_kwargs)
+        # Keep the meta value on the node, where matching can read it
+        proxy.node.meta["val"] = getattr(proxy, "meta", None)
+        return proxy
+
+
+def _module_call(self: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs):
+    return nn.Module.__call__(self, *args, **kwargs)
+
+
+def trace_classification_model(model: nn.Module) -> fx.Graph | None:
+    """Trace `model.forward` up to wherever tracing stops (usually the loss)."""
+    cls = type(model)
+    tracer = _ClassifierTracer()
+    tracer.varkw = next(
+        (
+            p.name
+            for p in forward_parameters(cls).values()
+            if p.kind is inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD
+        ),
+        None,
+    )
+    # fx traces `type(model).forward`, which Transformers wraps in decorators
+    unwrapped = type(cls.__name__, (cls,), {"forward": inspect.unwrap(cls.forward)})
+    model.__class__ = unwrapped
+    # `@support_torch_compile` overrides `__call__`, which would hide the base model
+    # call from fx, so restore the (fx patched) `nn.Module.__call__`
+    base = model.get_submodule(model.base_model_prefix)
+    base_cls = type(base)
+    base.__class__ = type(base_cls.__name__, (base_cls,), {"__call__": _module_call})
+    # `forward` sets `config.problem_type` because the traced `labels` isn't `None`
+    config = model.config
+    model.config = copy.deepcopy(config)
+    try:
+        return tracer.trace(model)
+    except Exception:
+        return getattr(tracer, "graph", None)
+    finally:
+        model.__class__ = cls
+        base.__class__ = base_cls
+        model.config = config
+
+
+def _descendants(node: fx.Node) -> set[fx.Node]:
+    seen: set[fx.Node] = set()
+    stack = [node]
+    while stack:
+        for user in stack.pop().users:
+            if user not in seen:
+                seen.add(user)
+                stack.append(user)
+    return seen
+
+
+def _ancestors(node: fx.Node) -> set[fx.Node]:
+    seen: set[fx.Node] = set()
+    stack = [node]
+    while stack:
+        for arg in stack.pop().all_input_nodes:
+            if arg not in seen:
+                seen.add(arg)
+                stack.append(arg)
+    return seen
+
+
+def _hidden_and_classifier(
+    graph: fx.Graph, module: nn.Module
+) -> tuple[fx.Node, fx.Node] | None:
+    """The base model's last hidden state and the classifier call, if traced."""
+    base = find_node(
+        graph,
+        lambda n: n.op == "call_module" and n.target == module.base_model_prefix,
+    )
+    classifier = find_node(
+        graph,
+        lambda n: n.op == "call_module" and n.target in ("classifier", "score"),
+    )
+    if base is None or classifier is None:
+        return None
+    hidden = find_node(
+        graph,
+        lambda n: len(n.args) == 2
+        and n.args[0] is base
+        and (
+            (n.target is operator.getitem and n.args[1] == 0)
+            or (n.target is getattr and n.args[1] == "last_hidden_state")
+        ),
+    )
+    return None if hidden is None else (hidden, classifier)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ClassifierFuser(BaseFuser):
+    """Fuser for the head between the pooled hidden states and the classifier."""
+
+    head: fx.Graph
+    """The head, from the pooled hidden states to the classifier's output."""
+
+    module_names: list[str]
+    """Names of the model's children called by `head`."""
+
+    redefines_forward = False
+
+    def info(self, name: str) -> str:
+        return f"Fused: {' -> '.join(self.module_names)} ({name}) -> head"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def match(
+        cls, graph: fx.Graph, module: nn.Module, *, pooled: bool = True
+    ) -> "ClassifierFuser | None":
+        """Match a head that only transforms hidden states that vLLM can pool.
+
+        If `pooled`, the model must pool in plain tensor ops (e.g. ModernBERT's
+        `[:, 0]` or masked mean), which vLLM's pooler replaces. A module that pools
+        (DeBERTa's `pooler`, RoBERTa's `classifier`), a base model output other
+        than the last hidden state (BERT's `pooler_output`), or a trace that stops
+        before the classifier (DistilBERT's inline `nn.ReLU()`) are not matched.
+        """
+        nodes = _hidden_and_classifier(graph, module)
+        if nodes is None:
+            return None
+        hidden, classifier = nodes
+
+        # Everything downstream of `hidden` that the classifier's output depends on
+        region = _descendants(hidden) & (_ancestors(classifier) | {classifier})
+        order = [n for n in graph.nodes if n in region]
+
+        def head_from(start: fx.Node) -> list[fx.Node] | None:
+            """The nodes after `start`, if they depend on nothing else."""
+            head = [n for n in order if n in _descendants(start)]
+            inputs = {arg for node in head for arg in node.all_input_nodes}
+            return head if inputs <= {start, *head} else None
+
+        if not pooled:
+            start = hidden
+            head = head_from(start)
+        else:
+            # The head starts at the first pooled node that the rest depends on alone
+            candidates = (
+                n
+                for n in order
+                if n is not classifier
+                and isinstance(val := n.meta.get("val"), torch.Tensor)
+                and val.ndim == 2
+            )
+            start, head = next(
+                ((n, h) for n in candidates if (h := head_from(n)) is not None),
+                (hidden, None),
+            )
+            # vLLM's pooler can only replace pooling done in plain tensor ops
+            pooling = _ancestors(start) & region | {start}
+            if any(n.op == "call_module" for n in pooling):
+                return None
+        if head is None:
+            return None
+
+        graph_head = fx.Graph()
+        env = {start: graph_head.placeholder("hidden_states")}
+        for node in head:
+            env[node] = graph_head.node_copy(node, env.__getitem__)
+        graph_head.output(env[classifier])
+        module_names = [str(n.target) for n in head if n.op == "call_module"]
+        return cls(head=graph_head, module_names=module_names)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def classifies_hidden_states(graph: fx.Graph, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
+        """Whether the classifier reads the last hidden state, ignoring dropout.
+
+        If so, applying the classifier alone to vLLM's pooled hidden states is
+        equivalent to the model's own head (e.g. RoBERTa, or decoders' `score`).
+        """
+        nodes = _hidden_and_classifier(graph, module)
+        if nodes is None:
+            return False
+        hidden, classifier = nodes
+        node = classifier.args[0]
+        while (
+            isinstance(node, fx.Node)
+            and node.op == "call_module"
+            and isinstance(module.get_submodule(str(node.target)), nn.Dropout)
+        ):
+            node = node.args[0]
+        return node is hidden
+
+    @classmethod
+    def match_model(
+        cls, module: nn.Module, *, pooled: bool
+    ) -> "ClassifierFuser | None":
+        """Trace a `For*Classification` model and match its head."""
+        graph = trace_classification_model(module)
+        return None if graph is None else cls.match(graph, module, pooled=pooled)
+
+    def validate(self, module: nn.Module, vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    def fuse(
+        self, module: nn.Module, prefix: str, vllm_config: "VllmConfig"
+    ) -> nn.Module:
+        """Run the head in the model dtype and only the classifier in `head_dtype`."""
+        model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+        graph = self.head
+        hidden_states = next(iter(graph.nodes))
+        classifier = next(n for n in reversed(graph.nodes) if n.op == "output").args[0]
+        with graph.inserting_after(hidden_states):
+            to_model = graph.call_method("to", (hidden_states, model_config.dtype))
+        hidden_states.replace_all_uses_with(
+            to_model, delete_user_cb=lambda user: user is not to_model
+        )
+        with graph.inserting_before(classifier):
+            to_head = graph.call_method(
+                "to", (classifier.args[0], model_config.head_dtype)
